answer: Reaching the terrace of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a security-first mindset, threat model explicit register, it stays short. The design leans on commit-reveal schemes for front-running resistance. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The vine holds work receipts rather than names, so the whisper of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
